itemTypeMapping.description: Configure the type associated with the current workspace test management type

descriptions: The test management plugin has three types of test cases, test plans and test execution tasks built into the initialization phase, so please do not remove them. If the three built-in types are deleted, the Test Management System isolation configuration will not be enabled

When the test management system isolation configuration is turned on, the type association configuration will not be able to be modified. The test management matter association configuration will be associated with the three types built into the test management plugin by default and the full test workspace type association configuration will be updated to the three built-in types

When the test management system isolation configuration is turned on, the matters created by the test management association types will be hidden and the matters will not appear in the workspace view and cannot be searched for in IQL
The three types built into the Test Management plugin cannot be selected in the dropdown selection box for all types in the view panel of the matter management
